definition_en: To successfully complete something or get a good result, especially through hard work.
examples: She worked hard to achieve her dreams.
They have achieved remarkable success in a short period of time.

definition_en: A helpful or good effect, or something intended to help.
examples: Regular exercise brings many health benefits.
The new policy will be of great benefit to students.

definition_en: Something needing great mental or physical effort in order to be done successfully.
examples: Learning a new language is a big challenge.
Our team is ready to face any challenge.

definition_en: To see, find, or become aware of something for the first time.
examples: Scientists discovered a new species in the rainforest.
She discovered that she had a talent for painting.

definition_en: Physical or mental energy needed to do something.
examples: You need to make an effort to improve your English.
Success requires time, patience, and effort.
